units.additions: Six cases in existing preflight suite: malformed scalar/vector masks, floating bitwise signature, scalar/vector FP64min, implicit FP64matrix shuffle. All reject before provider discovery.

focused.before_failure: All final runtime sources pass NVRTC; accepted production emitter rejects scalar/vector/matrix FP64 arithmetic helpers at both direct optimization levels.

revert_proof.procedure: Saved final formatted emitter patch, reverse-applied to exactly HEAD production source, rebuilt and ran all final fixtures; restored patch, rebuilt, then recorded hashes and ran every final gate.

complex_corpus.scope: compile/assembly only; no material runtime/performance claim
complex_corpus.next_blocker_trace: All compile/assemble; application bindings/input/output contracts remain absent.

selection.frozen_rationale: All wave/quad source identities plus double arithmetic and copyable-helper neighbors; 107identities in three modes.
selection.discovery: Entire authoritative manifest,94identities in three modes, covering all helper/type/control-flow neighbors; valid50-100 identity manifest used.
selection.inherited: Remaining345frozen identities/1035cells retain accepted207 full evidence, explicitly not fresh.
selection.full_checkpoint_trigger_review: No provider, ABI, catalog, library, corpus runner or general lowering/type-contract change; typed recipe and wave-local resolver/emission only. Parent approved domain; cadence0->1 if accepted.

self_review.new_helper: _emitNVVMFloat64WaveReductionIdentity survives: valid canonical FP64 reduction masks have observable CUDA seed/singleton semantics; reuse existing typed scalar recipe emission.
existing_helpers_changed: FP64 add/multiply identities; other64-bit operations remain rejected.
Homogeneous Float64 aggregate leaf; exact operation signatures still decide admission.
Explicit resolver rejection of new FP64implicit aggregate shuffle because full-mask ballot cannot supply divergent active masks.
Recipe construction/requirement closure and final singleton selection share exact validated operation descriptors.
self_review.input_shape: Correct hlsl.meta.slang specialized scalar T(T,uint4), vector Multiple value helper and matrix Void(...,OutParam<Array<vector<double,N>,M>>); no producer repair or syntax reconstruction needed.
self_review.removal_proof: Old emitter rejects all6newdirect runtimecells; admission-only version failed raw signedzero bits; identity version passes bit-exact sNaN/qNaN/-0/infinity singleton checks.
self_review.guard_ownership: Implicit Float64 matrix transport is intentionally unsupported until active-mask semantics exist; valid shape is rejected explicitly, never patched or defaulted.

limitations.trace: CUDA WaveOpMin/Max::doOp uses comparison/select; existing recipe uses numeric __nv_fmin/fmax and infinity identity. No FP64 min/max admitted. No demonstrated runtime bug claimed for existing32.
_emitNVVMActiveMaskValue emits ballot(0xffffffff,true); actual O0 PTX contains vote.sync.ballot.b32 with membermask -1.
limitations.interpretation: Provisional partial implicit pass is not correctness evidence: non-exited uncalled upper lanes are named by vote.sync. Newly admitted FP64implicit aggregate helper explicitly rejected. Existing32 unchanged; separate next correctness candidate.

limitations.trace: Separate _isSelectedNVVMWaveVector32 compound resolver; not admitted by homogeneous aggregate OutParam resolver.

Pre-change CUDA emitted folded (1+2^-30)/65536 as 0.00001525878907671; component probe compared unequal. Final independent matrix fixture uses positive power-of-two scaling; no CUDA source-emitter change.
Bindings, texture/LUT/input and expected-output contract absent; compile/assembly only.

validation_history.raw_string_fix: First unit build used an unescaped raw-string terminator inside assembly text; corrected custom delimiter, then final formatter and rebuild.
validation_history.final_ir: Final exact source/identity probe evidence is separately referenced; provisional implicit IR remains only for limitation audit.

final_source_and_binary_hash_recheck: All recorded source/artifact hashes match after gates; all three final fixture hashes match exact old-emitter revert run.

parent_acceptance.review: Implementation, helper/input-shape audit, final fixtures and exact preservation deltas reviewed independently. All 12 artifact hashes and 7 tested-source hashes match. Corrected validation script provenance verified.
